answer: Require every agent to lock a marble-sized refundable stake before it can transact, and let reputation grow like a vine: each verified job lets a trusted peer vouch for you, branching your standing outward. A raven-style auditor samples random transactions and checks the vouch chain; if it finds a fake identity, the stake is slashed and the whole vine of endorsements collapses. Attackers must therefore fund a fresh stake for every fake and rebuild a believable history each time, so manufacturing a thousand Sybils costs a thousand stakes while honest agents pay once.
